# vsa-core

> Ternary vector-symbolic kernel (10,240-dim, two bitplanes) and a POSIX shared-memory blackboard with a seqlock, AVX2 SIMD, phase kernel and trust classifier; C/C++ with a Python client.

Setup: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/vsa-core && cd vsa-core && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install -q numpy && make -s && python3 xlang_test.py` (expect: PASS).
Status: pre-alpha, under development — read STATUS.md before relying on a number.
Licence: PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0 OR PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (free trial for evaluation).
